## Recover concepts + HTML from past executions

Reads every execution of the carousel workflow through the n8n API and writes
everything into ONE folder (Settings > HTML_OUT_DIR),
named <original_folder_name>__post<N>:

  concept_post<N>.json   what Claude wrote, normalised - edit this
  carousel_post<N>.html  the exact HTML that was rendered - or edit this

**Before the first run**
1. Back up the n8n database. Execution data is pruned after 14 days by default.
2. Settings > N8N_API_KEY: create one under Settings > n8n API in the UI.
3. Settings > N8N_API_URL: from inside the n8n container this is
   http://localhost:5678/api/v1
4. Leave DRY_RUN on for the first run. Nothing is written; the manifest tells
   you how many posts were found and whether the folders match.
5. Turn DRY_RUN off and run it again.

Downloads are streamed to disk and base64 slide images are discarded while
reading, so a multi-gigabyte execution costs about 30 MB of memory.

The manifest lands in WORK_DIR/manifest.json. Read `collisions` in it: the
source workflow's folder name has no post index, so a paper that produced
2 or 3 posts wrote them all into one folder and the later post overwrote the
earlier one's images. Every concept is recovered; those images are not.
